answer: Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The wharf graph is validated at intake and the bridge frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and horizon anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Forging one identity takes 7 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 233 takes that multiplied out, plus 67 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
